blocks.title: Private cloud
blocks.text: A private cloud is used by one organization only. It can be hosted on the organization's premises or by a third party, but it is not shared.
A large bank may keep sensitive customer data in a private cloud in its own data centres, or one run for it by a provider, which only the bank can access.

blocks.prompt: How does a private cloud differ from a public cloud (MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: (c) it is dedicated to a single organization and offers more control over data and security.

items: Private cloud: one organization, more control and security (a bank's data).
